packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch and minor updates once CI is green (branch protection on main requires all 4 checks); major bumps still open a PR for manual review.
@playwright/test must equal nixpkgs playwright-driver.version (browsers come from the nix store, see compat-playwright/package.json). Bump by hand together with the flake nixpkgs pin.
workspace-hack/Cargo.toml is generated by cargo-hakari; a Renovate bump there diverges from the real graph and breaks resolution.
